title: Dark matter glueball candidate from a $G(2)$--$E_6$--$E_7$ exceptional grand unified theory: $G$-parity, spin, mass and stability
summary: We determine the gauge-invariant identity, mass scale and ultraviolet stability of the dark matter candidate arising from \(G(2)\to SU(3)_C\) in the exceptional \(G(2)\!-\!E_6\!-\!E_7\) construction. The broken \(G(2)\) sector contains odd \(1^{+-}\) and \(0^{--}\) channels, whereas the scalar \(0^{++}\sim X\bar X\) state is even and unprotected. For \(m_X\simeq5.7\times10^{13}\,\mathrm{GeV}\), weak-binding reference masses are \(M_{2X}\simeq1.14\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{GeV}\) and \(M_{3X}\simeq1.71\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{GeV}\), while the exact pole masses remain nonperturbative.…
